item.title: Auto-Updating Docker Containers - Renovate + Forgejo + Komodo
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: I set up Renovate to scan docker-compose files on its own, open PRs in Forgejo with new image versions, and let Komodo redeploy the stack automatically after merge.
